title: AI Ads Moderator Agent: Stop Trolls from Sinking Your ROAS
body:
Are your best Facebook or Instagram ads losing sales because of comments?

You invest thousands of dollars in perfect ad campaigns, but it only takes one comment from a troll (or a competitor) saying "This is a scam" or "It's cheaper on AliExpress" to sink your conversion rate. While you sleep, those toxic comments remain visible for hours, scaring away hundreds of potential customers and ruthlessly burning your ROAS (Return on Ad Spend).

The Trap of Manual Social Media Moderation

Trying to delete or reply to comments by hand is a losing battle. If your campaign goes viral, your team won't be able to keep up, and standard Meta keyword filters are easily bypassed by malicious users. Reaction time is money: a negative comment visible for just 5 minutes has already ruined dozens of paid clicks..

Our Solution: AI Ads Moderator Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO, we design and integrate an Artificial Intelligence Agent connected directly to the Meta and TikTok Ads APIs. This AI analyzes the semantic intent of every comment in milliseconds, making real-time decisions without human intervention.

  1. Instant toxicity hiding: It detects unjustified complaints, insults, or mentions of competitors and hides the comment instantly, protecting your ad's social proof.
  2. 24/7 purchase doubt resolution: If a user asks "Do you ship to London?" or "What size am I?", the AI Agent replies in a second using your catalog's information.
  3. Spam and Bot filtering: Automatically removes fraudulent links, crypto promotions, and spam that infest winning ads.
  4. Strategic sales routing: Identifies high-intent purchase comments and sends them an automated Direct Message (DM) with a payment link or discount code.

The Real Impact on Your B2C and E-commerce Campaigns

  • Direct ROAS increase: By keeping the comments section clean and positive, your Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) drops dramatically.
  • Zero overnight losses: Your campaign keeps selling and being moderated at 3 AM without needing to pay for an overnight Community Manager.
  • Higher conversion through immediacy: Technical or shipping doubts resolved in under 5 seconds multiply the probability of closing the sale.
